notes:
# Orvio 0.08

- Fixes a crash on phones when leaving Live TV with a very large playlist: Orvio ran out of memory. It now uses less memory for the catalog and may use more when the library is large.
- Faster start with large playlists, with a loading bar that shows what is being read ("Loading 144,366 movies…"). The Android 12+ launch screen is dark instead of white, and the Orvio logo appears at once.
- Live TV opens on the channel you watched last instead of the provider's first channel. Home shows your favorite channels, otherwise your recently watched ones.
- Home prefers movies and series with artwork and hides empty rows.
- Searching or choosing a category in Live TV starts at the top of the results.
- Removes the duplicate header when adding a playlist from Settings on phones.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
